description: Reads a crawl started by start_site_crawl. While it runs, result has status (queued or running) and pagesDone; call again in 20 to 30 seconds. Once done, result has the site-wide findings and the crawled pages with their problems, 10 pages per call: pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next 10; nextCursor is null on the last page. A failed crawl has status failed and error. An unknown or expired job id is an error. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), reportUrl (a shareable report page for the person, kept 30 days; null for tools that keep none) and result (the details below). Errors come back as one plain sentence.

cursor.description: Where the page list starts, from nextCursor. Defaults to 0.

name: get_site_crawl
title: Get the site crawl results
